headline: Council approved a live poultry market at 785 Page Boulevard and a gas station rebrand at 1313 Boston Road; zoning changes were continued.
summary: Members approved a live poultry market at 785 Page Boulevard. They also approved a gas station rebrand at 1313 Boston Road and a used car sales change at 1469 State Street. They continued the zoning ordinance amendments and withdrew the temporary sign section.
decisions: Approved the live poultry market at 785 Page Boulevard.
Approved the amendment to the special permit for a gas station rebrand at 1313 Boston Road.
Approved a change of petitioner for used car sales at 1469 State Street.
Withdrew the temporary sign section from the zoning ordinance amendments.
Continued the zoning ordinance amendments, including data centers, to a later hearings meeting.
discussion: Live poultry market: Speakers described on-site retail slaughter of halal chickens. Members asked about other animals, avian flu, and parking near the site.

Zoning ordinance amendments: Staff described new rules for data centers, downtown surface parking, and trailer storage. Members asked about trailer length, accessory dwelling setbacks, and daycare rules before the item was continued.
Temporary signs: Members said limits on political and business signs could restrict what people may display.
Used car sales at 1469 State Street: A councilor asked the new operator to present to the neighborhood association.
Proclamations: The council read proclamations honoring the Springfield Armory, Birth of Basketball, Black Men of Greater Springfield, and the Springfield Puerto Rican Parade.
